name: Tina
headline: AI Researcher → Forward Deployed Engineer · LLM pipelines, retrieval and evaluation
summary: I started in operations, training entity models for enterprise clients, taught myself analytics engineering, and moved into AI research, where I built LLM pipelines that replaced days of manual work with minutes of automated, measured output. I've been the operator who did the work by hand, so I build AI for how the work is actually done, and I prove it with numbers the business cares about.

roles.title: AI Researcher, Retrieval Engine
roles.summary: Moved from operations into the AI Research team to build LLM pipelines for entity alignment and retrieval.

highlights.text: Built an LLM entity-alignment pipeline that replaced a manual process taking 6.5 days per 1,000 entities: it now aligns 5,000 entities in under 30 minutes at about $0.0005 per entity.
Evaluated the pipeline against an external expert-labelling vendor's labels and reached 94.5% to 97% agreement.
Automated entity trigger-word generation, cutting the work from 1,350 hours to 3.7 hours a month and the cost from about £6k to under $2 a month.
Demoed both pipelines to product, engineering and operations stakeholders.
Took part in real-world evaluation of the next-generation entity retrieval technology, a contribution recognised by the Retrieval Engine team.

roles.title: Technical Product Analyst, Concept Operations
roles.summary: Owned entity training for enterprise clients and taught myself analytics engineering along the way.

highlights.text: Led entity training for a major enterprise client: 3,266 entities in scope, 2,155 trained, 47.9% more trained during the prioritisation period and 4,248 entities through the bulk entity-creation pipeline.

Ran bulk entity requests for enterprise clients and wrote the training-process overview, vendor alignment instructions, entity tracker and bulk-request templates; several were still in use three years later.
Taught myself dbt, Git and SQL, then shipped reviewed changes to the company's dbt analytics models (Salesforce cases, concepts and Jira issues).
Set up a parallel Jira workflow to migrate topic labelling to a new external labelling provider without disrupting delivery.
Built the cost analysis for the Entities 2.0 programme for leadership, and proposed time-in-status tracking for social-author operations.
Worked on a LightGBM churn-prediction model and fixed the Salesforce churn fields it depended on.

projects.name: Career Intelligence Platform (this site)
projects.summary: A shared career knowledge base that powers both this portfolio and an AI job-match engine, deployed with CI/CD on Vercel.

highlights.text: Designed a modular system: one structured knowledge base feeds a public portfolio and a matching API, with private data kept out of the public repo.
Built the site and a serverless match API in Next.js and TypeScript, deployed on Vercel with GitHub Actions running lint, type checks, tests and a build on every pull request.
Implemented explainable job matching: requirement extraction, evidence retrieval and weighted scoring, with a yes/no labelling loop to collect training data for a future classifier.
